text:
dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 千星沙箱模拟器：简体中文 | [English](README.en.md) | [Quick Guide](https://ppt.070077.xyz/beyond-ai/index.html)

面向千星奇域 **2D + Lua 游戏开发**的独立模拟器。在浏览器中编辑 UI、运行脚本、试玩调试，也可以让 AI 直接操作、截图和测试，完成后导出资产到游戏中验证。

提供 **Web 编辑器、MCP 服务和 DeepSeek Harness 插件**，支持 OpenCode、WorkBuddy、Codex 等 AI 工具。

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 包含什么：| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **可视化 UI 编辑** | 创建 11 类客户端控件，调整层级、位置、尺寸、锚点和属性。 |
| **Lua 脚本运行** | 管理多个脚本，挂载到客户端控件或模板，调试输入与动画。 |
| **独立试玩** | 支持鼠标、触摸和按键，可暂停、单步并查看日志。 |
| **设备与多人模拟** | 提供 5 种 PC / 手机画布，支持本地 1–8 人试玩与视角切换。 |
| **AI 自动测试** | 编辑工程、发送输入、截图，录制和回放测试用例。 |
| **七步制作工作流** | 从策划、TDD、HTML 演示到美术、Lua 实现、测试与真机验证。 |
| **存档与资产交换** | 保存完整 JSON 工程，导入导出 UI、Lua 和已支持的 GIA 内容。 |

控件能力详见 [客户端控件支持矩阵](studio/docs/control-support.md)。

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 集成方式：| 方式 | 适用场景 |
|---|---|
| **[Web 编辑器](#web-部署)** | 在浏览器中独立编辑和试玩，或查看 AI 修改后的工程。 |
| **[MCP 服务](#mcp-接入)** | 让 OpenCode、WorkBuddy、Codex 等 AI 工具直接编辑和测试。 |
| **[DeepSeek Harness 插件](#deepseek-harness-插件)** | 在 Harness 内使用编辑器、模拟器工具和游戏制作 Agent。 |

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · Web 部署：需要 **Node.js 22+**：

```sh
npm install -g beyond-simulator-web
mkdir ../my-game
beyond-simulator-web --workspace ../my-game --open
```

`my-game` 用于保存游戏文件；已有工程可直接指定目录，例如 `--workspace E:/my-game`。

- [编辑器](http://127.0.0.1:4173/editor)：编辑、保存和试玩。
- [存档预览](http://127.0.0.1:4173/)：查看已保存的工程，文件更新后自动刷新。

支持 Docker 部署。对外提供服务时需配置访问口令和 HTTPS，适合单个可信操作者使用。详见 [Web 指南](web/README.md)。

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · MCP 接入：需要 Node.js 22+，以及支持本地 MCP stdio 的 AI 客户端：

```sh
npm install -g beyond-simulator-mcp
```

在客户端添加本地 stdio 服务：

| 配置项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 服务名（自定） | `qxqy-simulator` |
| 命令 | `beyond-simulator-mcp` |
| 参数 | `--workspace`、已有游戏目录的绝对路径，例如 `E:/my-game` |

配置参考：[OpenCode](https://opencode.ai/docs/mcp-servers/)、[WorkBuddy](https://open.workbuddy.cn/docs/connector)、[Codex](mcp/README.md#codex-接入)。接入后应能看到 `qxqy_project_open`、`qxqy_studio_play` 等工具。
dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · MCP 接入：MCP 可独立使用，也可与 Web 指向同一工作区：AI 保存工程后，即可在 Web 存档预览中查看。完整配置见 [MCP 指南](mcp/README.md)。

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · DeepSeek Harness 插件：需要 Node.js 22+ 和 DeepSeek Harness：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator
dsh web
```

为会话绑定游戏工作区，打开「模拟器」视图。新建会话时可选择「千星 2D+Lua 游戏制作」Agent 预设。

更新时重新执行安装命令并重启 Harness；已有用户 Agent 预设会保留。GitHub / 本地包安装及版本兼容说明见 [Harness 插件指南](dsh-plugin/README.md)。

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 用 Agent 七步制作游戏：提供游戏想法、参考图或已有工程，在 Harness 中选择游戏制作 Agent，或让其他 AI 工具读取 [七步制作 Skill](agent/wonderland-lua-builder/skills/qxqy-game-studio/SKILL.md)，通过 MCP 开始制作。

| 步骤 | 产出 |
|---|---|
| **1. 策划案** | 核心玩法、操作、计分与胜负规则。 |
| **2. TDD 测试用例** | 开局、成功、失败、重开及边界情况的操作与预期。 |
| **3. HTML 演示** | 可试玩的效果展示，用于确认画面、操作和节奏。 |
| **4. 千星美术素材** | 参考图、素材清单与 UI 还原方案。 |
| **5. Lua 实现** | 可运行的游戏脚本与完整存档。 |
| **6. 测试** | AI 试玩、问题修复与回归结果。 |
| **7. 真机验证** | 导入、脚本挂载与更新说明，以及真机反馈修复。 |

text: dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 用 Agent 七步制作游戏：开始前需连接可用的官方 2D/Lua 知识来源，例如 `miliastra-toolbox` 或本地文档；安装包不含官方知识库。配置与流程见 [Agent / Skill 指南](agent/wonderland-lua-builder/README.md)。
section: 用 Agent 七步制作游戏

text: dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 1. 准备工程：一个存档包含 **服务端 UI、客户端控件模板和 Lua 脚本**。可从零创建，也可通过顶栏「工作区存档」打开已有工程，或用「导入」载入 JSON、GIA 和 Lua。

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 2. 编辑并试玩：1. 在「UI 编辑」中添加控件，切换 PC / 手机画布检查布局。
2. 在「Lua 脚本」中创建或导入脚本，挂载到客户端控件或模板；模板脚本在实例化时运行。
3. 按需在「服务端逻辑」中配置变量和信号。
4. 点击「试玩 ↗」，使用暂停、单步和「日志」排查问题，也可调整人数并切换玩家视角。宿主不支持新窗口时会进入内嵌试玩，通过「返回编辑」「关闭试玩」或 Escape 返回。

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 3. 让 AI 帮你测试：接入 MCP 或 Harness 后，可直接说明操作与预期，例如：

> 打开我的存档，在手机 16:9 画布试玩。点击开始，再点击目标，检查得分是否增加 1，截图并查看日志。把这组操作记录成测试用例，修改后重新回放。

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 4. 保存与导出：| 目的 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| 继续开发或备份 | 导出「资产包 JSON（三类合一）」，保留 UI、脚本和挂载关系。 |
| 保存到工作区 | 点击「保存存档」，填写相对路径，例如 `my-game.save.json`。 |
| 导入官方编辑器 | 导出对应 GIA，检查导出提示及导入效果。 |
| 单独交换 UI 或脚本 | 导出当前界面 Authoring JSON、脚本包或单个 Lua。 |

编辑和试玩不会自动把完整存档写入磁盘，请在退出前保存；使用 MCP 时可让 AI 调用保存工具。

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 5. 导入真机并持续更新：将资产和脚本导入千星沙箱后，核对实际控件 / 模板索引，并同步 Lua 引用。

后续可让 AI 更新已绑定的脚本目录，也可通过「Lua 脚本 → 实机脚本同步」绑定目录、预览差异并确认复制，再到千星沙箱保存并重新试玩。新增脚本仍需建立映射和挂载；无法直接访问游戏目录时可手动更新。

详见 [真机交付与验证](agent/wonderland-lua-builder/skills/qxqy-game-studio/references/07-device-validation.md)和 [实机脚本同步](studio/docs/script-sync.md)。

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 当前支持边界：- **模拟器通过不等于真机通过**，最终需在千星奇域中验证。
- **多人试玩为本地模拟**，服务端覆盖变量与信号，不包含完整官方节点图或网络联机。
- **图片**支持基础图元、静态素材、元件图标及「基础／拉伸」模式；3D 模型不在预览范围。详见 [素材说明](studio/docs/image-assets.md)。
- **界面／全屏动效**支持浏览器预览与 Lua 试玩，资源失败仅跳过对应动效；无头 PNG 省略视频帧，非空动效 GIA 配置待核实。详见 [动效播放](studio/docs/ui-vfx-playback.md)。
- **Lua 2D 音效**支持试玩播放，素材按需下载。详见 [音频说明](studio/docs/audio-assets.md)。
- **GIA 支持已验证的内容子集**，请关注导出提示，保留原始文件和完整 JSON 存档。

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 从源码构建：需要 Node.js 22+、pnpm 10.15.0，在仓库根目录运行：

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build
pnpm test
```

自行打包和发布见 [分发说明](DISTRIBUTION.md)。

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 界面语言与更新：顶部「字体设置」旁可切换语言；自动模式跟随系统语言，非中文环境默认英文。底栏提供「检查更新」和「联系作者」。详见 [界面说明](studio/docs/interface.md)。
dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 本地自定义字体：在「字体设置」中选择本地 TTF/OTF 或系统字体，也可自动查找 Windows 原神安装目录。保存后重启宿主并刷新页面，设置仅保存在本机。详见 [字体说明](studio/docs/local-fonts.md)。

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · Miliastra Sandbox Simulator：[简体中文](README.md) | English | [Quick Guide](https://ppt.070077.xyz/beyond-ai/index.html)

A standalone simulator for **2D + Lua game development in Miliastra Wonderland**. Edit UI, run scripts, and playtest in your browser, or let AI interact with the game, capture screenshots, and run tests. Export assets for verification in the game.

Available as a **Web editor, an MCP server, and a DeepSeek Harness plugin**, with support for AI tools such as OpenCode, WorkBuddy, and Codex.

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · Features：| Capability | Description |
|---|---|
| **Visual UI editing** | Create 11 client control types and adjust hierarchy, location, size, anchors, and properties. |
| **Lua execution** | Manage multiple scripts, attach them to client controls or Client Control Templates, and debug input and animations. |
| **Standalone playtests** | Use mouse, touch, or keyboard input; pause, step through execution, and inspect logs. |
| **Device and multiplayer simulation** | Choose from five PC/mobile canvases and simulate 1–8 local players with perspective switching. |
| **AI automated tests** | Edit projects, send input, capture screenshots, and record and replay test cases. |
| **Seven-step workflow** | Progress through design, TDD, an HTML demo, art, Lua implementation, testing, and in-game validation. |
| **Saves and asset exchange** | Save complete JSON projects and import/export UI, Lua, and supported GIA content. |
dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · Features：See the [client control support matrix](studio/docs/control-support.md) for details.

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · Integrations：| Integration | Use case |
|---|---|
| **[Web editor](#web-deployment)** | Edit and playtest in your browser, or view projects modified by AI. |
| **[MCP server](#mcp-integration)** | Let OpenCode, WorkBuddy, Codex, and other AI tools edit and test directly. |
| **[DeepSeek Harness plugin](#deepseek-harness-plugin)** | Use the editor, simulator tools, and game creation agent inside Harness. |

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · Web deployment：Requires **Node.js 22+**:

```sh
npm install -g beyond-simulator-web
mkdir ../my-game
beyond-simulator-web --workspace ../my-game --open
```

`my-game` stores your game files. For an existing project, specify its directory instead, for example `--workspace E:/my-game`.

- [Editor](http://127.0.0.1:4173/editor): edit, save, and playtest.
- [Save preview](http://127.0.0.1:4173/): view saved projects, with automatic refresh when files change.

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · Web deployment：Docker deployment is also supported. For external access, configure an access password and HTTPS. The service is intended for a single trusted operator. See the [Web guide](web/README.md).

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · MCP integration：Requires Node.js 22+ and an AI client with local MCP stdio support:

```sh
npm install -g beyond-simulator-mcp
```

Add a local stdio server in your client:

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Server name (your choice) | `qxqy-simulator` |
| Command | `beyond-simulator-mcp` |
| Arguments | `--workspace`, followed by an existing game directory's absolute path, such as `E:/my-game` |

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · MCP integration：Configuration examples: [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai/docs/mcp-servers/), [WorkBuddy](https://open.workbuddy.cn/docs/connector), and [Codex](mcp/README.md#codex-接入). After connecting, tools such as `qxqy_project_open` and `qxqy_studio_play` should be available.

Use MCP independently or point it and Web to the same workspace. Once AI saves the project, view it in Web's save preview. See the [MCP guide](mcp/README.md) for full setup.

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · DeepSeek Harness plugin：Requires Node.js 22+ and DeepSeek Harness:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator
dsh web
```

Bind a game workspace to the session and open **Simulator**. For a new session, choose the **千星 2D+Lua 游戏制作** game creation agent preset.

To update, rerun the installation command and restart Harness; existing user agent presets are preserved. See the [Harness plugin guide](dsh-plugin/README.md) for GitHub/local package installation and version compatibility.

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · Build a game in seven steps with an agent：Provide a game idea, reference image, or existing project. Choose the game creation agent in Harness, or ask another AI tool to read the [seven-step Skill](agent/wonderland-lua-builder/skills/qxqy-game-studio/SKILL.md) and work through MCP.
section: Build a game in seven steps with an agent

text:
dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · Build a game in seven steps with an agent：| Step | Output |
|---|---|
| **1. Game design** | Core gameplay, controls, scoring, and win/loss rules. |
| **2. TDD test cases** | Actions and expected results for starting, success, failure, restarting, and edge cases. |
| **3. HTML demo** | A playable demo to confirm visuals, controls, and pacing. |
| **4. Miliastra art assets** | Reference art, an asset list, and a UI recreation plan. |
| **5. Lua implementation** | Playable game scripts and a complete save. |
| **6. Testing** | AI playtests, bug fixes, and regression results. |
| **7. In-game validation** | Import, script attachment, and update instructions, plus fixes based on in-game feedback. |
section: Build a game in seven steps with an agent

text: dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · Build a game in seven steps with an agent：Connect an accessible source of official 2D/Lua documentation first, such as `miliastra-toolbox` or local files. Packages do not include the official knowledge base. See the [agent and Skill guide](agent/wonderland-lua-builder/README.md).
section: Build a game in seven steps with an agent

text: dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 1. Prepare a project：A save contains **Server UI, Client Control Templates, and Lua scripts**. Start from scratch, open an existing project through **Workspace Saves**, or use **Import** to load JSON, GIA, and Lua files.

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 2. Edit and playtest：1. Add controls in **UI Editor** and switch between PC/mobile canvases to check layouts.
2. Create or import scripts in **Lua Scripts** and attach them to client controls or Client Control Templates. Template scripts run when the template is instantiated.
3. Configure variables and signals in **Server Logic** as needed.
4. Click **Playtest ↗**. Pause, step through execution, and check **Logs** to debug, or adjust the player count and switch perspectives. Hosts that block new windows use an embedded playtest; return with **Back to Editor**, **Close Playtest**, or Escape.

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 3. Let AI help you test：After connecting through MCP or Harness, describe the actions and expected results:

> Open my save on the mobile 16:9 canvas. Click start, then click the target and check that the score increases by 1. Take a screenshot and check the logs. Record these actions as a test case and replay it after changes.

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 4. Save and export：| Purpose | Action |
|---|---|
| Continue development or make a backup | Export **Complete Save JSON (all three asset types)** to retain UI, scripts, and attachments. |
| Save to the workspace | Click **Save Project** and enter a relative path, such as `my-game.save.json`. |
| Import into the official editor | Export the appropriate GIA and review export notices and the imported result. |
| Exchange UI or scripts separately | Export **Current UI Authoring JSON**, a script bundle, or an individual Lua script. |

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 4. Save and export：Editing and playtesting do not automatically write a complete save to disk. Save before exiting, or ask AI to call the save tool when using MCP.

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 5. Import into the game and keep scripts up to date：After importing assets and scripts into Miliastra Sandbox, check the actual control/template indices and update Lua references.

For later changes, ask AI to update the bound script folder, or use **Lua Scripts → Sync Scripts to Game** to bind a folder, preview changes, and confirm copying. Then save the stage in Miliastra Sandbox and playtest again. New scripts still need mappings and attachments. Update files manually if the game folder is inaccessible.
section: 5. Import into the game and keep scripts up to date

text: dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · 5. Import into the game and keep scripts up to date：See [in-game delivery and validation](agent/wonderland-lua-builder/skills/qxqy-game-studio/references/07-device-validation.md) and [script synchronization](studio/docs/script-sync.md).
section: 5. Import into the game and keep scripts up to date

text:
dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · Current support limits：- **Passing in the simulator does not guarantee passing in the game.** Final verification in Miliastra Wonderland is required.
- **Multiplayer playtests use local simulation.** Server support covers variables and signals, without the full official node graph or network multiplayer.
- **Images** support basic primitives, static assets, Prefab icons, and **Basic/Stretch** modes. 3D models are outside the preview scope. See [image assets](studio/docs/image-assets.md).
- **UI/fullscreen effects** support browser previews and Lua playtests, with failures isolated per effect. Headless PNG omits video frames; nonempty effect settings in GIA remain unverified. See [effect playback](studio/docs/ui-vfx-playback.md).
- **Lua 2D audio** can play during playtests, with assets downloaded on demand. See [audio assets](studio/docs/audio-assets.md).
- **GIA supports a verified subset of content.** Review export notices and keep original files and complete JSON saves.

dsh-plugin-beyond-simulator README · Build from source：Requires Node.js 22+ and pnpm 10.15.0. Run from the repository root:

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build
pnpm test
```

See the [distribution guide](DISTRIBUTION.md) for packaging and publishing.

千星沙箱模拟器（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中编辑和试玩千星奇域 2D+Lua 工程。它把模拟器编辑器接入 conversation.view，并为每个会话维护独立控制器。用户可以读取和修改 UI 工程、导入或导出 JSON/GIA/Lua，启动试玩、控制输入与多人视角、录制回放用例，并获取编辑器或运行时 PNG 截图；还可加载工作区存档及预览实机 Lua 脚本同步。适合制作和验证千星奇域客户端 UI 与 Lua 游戏的开发者。插件不要求 API Key；需要 DeepSeek Harness 和本地 Node.js 环境。

Miliastra Sandbox Simulator (DSH Web plugin): edit and playtest 2D+Lua projects in Harness. It adds session scoped tools for project edits, asset import/export, playtests, screenshots, saved projects, and script sync previews. For Miliastra Wonderland developers; no API key required.

千星沙箱模拟器的功能「工程快照与编辑」：读取当前会话 UI 工程 JSON 快照，并用带 revision 的 patch 更新工程。 通过 Harness 工具调用触发，输入为当前工程及动作参数，输出工程状态、文件或试玩结果。
千星沙箱模拟器的功能「资产导入与导出」：按控件选择预览并导出 GIA、JSON 或 Lua，也可导入工程存档。 通过 Harness 工具调用触发，输入为当前工程及动作参数，输出工程状态、文件或试玩结果。
千星沙箱模拟器的功能「交互试玩」：启动 Lua 试玩并控制设备画布、玩家视角、输入、暂停、步进、服务端变量与信号，也支持录制和回放用例。 通过 Harness 工具调用触发，输入为当前工程及动作参数，输出工程状态、文件或试玩结果。
千星沙箱模拟器的功能「PNG 截图」：分别获取编辑器舞台与试玩运行画面的 PNG。 通过 Harness 工具调用触发，输入为当前工程及动作参数，输出工程状态、文件或试玩结果。
千星沙箱模拟器的功能「工作区存档」：列出当前会话工作区存档，或按相对路径载入指定存档。 通过 Harness 工具调用触发，输入为当前工程及动作参数，输出工程状态、文件或试玩结果。
千星沙箱模拟器的功能「实机脚本同步」：发现和配置目标脚本目录，保存后预览差异，再应用确认的文件更新。 通过 Harness 工具调用触发，输入为当前工程及动作参数，输出工程状态、文件或试玩结果。
